verdict.rationale: Bento offers API/CLI access to subscriber data (search, filter, bulk operations) and explicitly advertises 'migration help when you switch' (bento-docs-11), implying some data portability, but there is no documented bulk-export endpoint or explicit open-format (CSV/JSON) full-account export feature — only import functionality is clearly documented. missing for 10: explicit bulk data export endpoint/CLI command, documented open-format export (CSV/JSON) of all subscriber/event/campaign data, independent confirmation that migration assistance actually delivers a full data export.
